overview_description.description: Finllect is a financial wellness and credit-building platform designed to empower the next generation of consumers with smarter financial tools and accessible credit opportunities. The company leverages open banking technology, behavioral insights, and alternative financial data to create a fairer and more inclusive credit scoring system, especially for users with limited or no traditional credit history. Its platform offers educational content, budgeting resources, rewards, cashback features, and a credit-building debit card that helps users strengthen their financial profiles without relying on conventional banking barriers. Finllect’s mission is to improve economic mobility by making credit more accessible, transparent, and personalized for young adults and underserved communities across the MENA region.

product.name: Finllect Card
product.description: A debit card that builds credit by linking multiple bank accounts and using everyday payments to improve credit scores without fees or interest.

product.name: Finllect App
product.description: A mobile app that enables users to build credit scores, prequalify for financial products, automate finances, and access financial education content.

product.name: Finllect Credit Engine for Lenders
product.description: An API-driven credit scoring engine that analyzes transactional data to provide lenders with insights for personalized lending decisions and risk assessment.

product.name: Finllect Ambassador Program
product.description: A referral program where ambassadors promote the Finllect Card and earn rewards, commissions, and exclusive perks for approved referrals.
